metadata.title: COSU Internet Kiosk Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Internet Kiosks as restricted-purpose endpoint execution environments.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint designed exclusively for controlled internet access or public-facing web interactions, with no general-purpose computing or institutional data handling capabilities.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Internet Kiosks inherit foundational trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to a locked-down browser or approved kiosk application set.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Kiosk usage does not rely on persistent individual user identity.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Internet Kiosk endpoints are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Internet Kiosk endpoints are centrally managed, monitored, and reset.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity may be established for management and integrity purposes but is not used for data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system and application configuration are locked down to remove shell access, local storage, removable media, and unauthorized interfaces.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved internet destinations and management services; no lateral access to institutional networks is permitted.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Local data persistence is prohibited; sessions are ephemeral and cleared automatically.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Internet Kiosks may only interact with public or minimally sensitive institutional data.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: A locked-down COSU endpoint does not imply high data trust or eligibility beyond its defined purpose.

props.name: posture-and-health-monitoring
props.remarks: Kiosk integrity, availability, and configuration drift are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Kiosks support rapid reset, reimage, and retirement workflows under Secure Endpoint lifecycle governance.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Internet Kiosks implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on function restriction, attack surface minimization, and rapid recovery.

roles.title: Kiosk Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, configuration enforcement, monitoring, and reset of Internet Kiosks.

roles.title: Endpoint Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Approves kiosk purposes, network restrictions, and lifecycle actions.

control-implementation.remarks: Internet Kiosk implementations are OS-specific (Windows kiosk mode, Linux kiosk shells, macOS single-app mode) and are maintained as controlled configuration artifacts aligned with this SSPP.
